date_from.description: ISO-8601 inclusive lower bound on `created_at`. Omit to skip the lower bound.

date_to.description: ISO-8601 exclusive upper bound on `created_at`. Pass to walk back past the result cap on subsequent calls (cursor-style: set to the `created_at` of the oldest record from the prior page).

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 100, hard cap 500).

skill_name.description: Exact-match filter on the recording scout's skill (e.g. `signals-scout-grouping-judge`). Omit to span every scout on the team.

subject.description: Exact-match filter on `subject` — every record about one entity, across runs.
